title: F**k Esc
description: This mod prevents you from accidentally pressing Esc by disabling it when you press Right Ctrl (you can change this key in the misc settings). It’s especially useful for PvP or long playthroughs.
body: This mod prevents the pause menu from opening when you press Esc, so you won’t accidentally interrupt your game. You can toggle it using Right Ctrl (customizable in the misc settings). It’s especially useful for PvP or long play sessions where opening the menu can get you killed or break your focus.
